flow cytometry.sample_type: blood, bone marrow, spleen, lung, lymph nodes, tonsil, gut single-cell suspensions
flow cytometry.readouts: NK cell frequencies; CD56bright CD16− and CD56dim CD16+ subset distribution; CD57, NKG2C, GzmB, FcεRIγ, CD69, CD103, CXCR6, CD49a, T-bet, TCF-1 expression

evidence_location.quote: NK cells were distinguished from other lymphocytes and myeloid lineage cells based on gating for CD45 + CD3 − CD14 − CD19 − CD56 + cells and further delineated into the major NK subsets, CD56 bright CD16 − and CD56 dim CD16 + ( Figure 1B ).

IFN-γ secretion following culture of sor.name_in_paper: IFN-γ secretion following culture of sorted NK cells with cytokines
aliases: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
IFN-γ secretion following culture of sor.sample_type: sorted NK cells from blood, bone marrow, spleen, lung, and lung-draining lymph nodes
IFN-γ secretion following culture of sor.readouts: frequency of IFN-γ+ NK cells after IL-12, IL-15, and IL-18 stimulation

evidence_location.quote: Culturing NK cells from blood, BM, spleen, lung, and LLNs with a cytokine cocktail (IL-12, IL-15, and IL-18) induced IFN-γ production with site-specific differences; BM NK cells had the highest frequency of IFN-γ producers followed by spleen, lung, and blood, with LN having the lowest frequency ( Figure 3C ).

CD107a expression following activation o.name_in_paper: CD107a expression following activation of NK cells by co-culture with K562 cells
aliases: For measuring degranulation by NK cells
CD107a expression following activation o.sample_type: sorted NK cells from multiple tissue sites co-cultured with K562 cells
CD107a expression following activation o.readouts: frequency of CD107a+ NK cells; degranulation potential

evidence_location.quote: We also tested the functional potential of NK cells activated in the presence of a MHC class I-negative tumor cell line in vitro by staining for the expression of lysosomal-associated membrane protein 1 (LAMP-1: CD107a), a marker for degranulation ( Alter et al., 2004 ). NK cells from all the sites showed similar CD107 expression and degranulation potential.

aliases: whole transcriptome profiling by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq)
RNA sequencing (RNA-seq).sample_type: sorted CD56 bright CD16− and CD56 dim CD16+ NK cells from blood, bone marrow, spleen, lung, and lung-draining lymph node
RNA sequencing (RNA-seq).readouts: whole-transcriptome gene expression; differentially expressed genes; subset- and tissue-specific transcriptional profiles

evidence_location.quote: To identify the molecular basis of differential tissue distribution and functionality between NK cell subsets, we performed whole transcriptome profiling by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) of CD56 bright CD16 − and CD56 dim CD16 + NK cells sorted from blood, BM, spleen, lung, and LLN.
